data.name: Holiday Inn Mexico Zona Centro by IHG
data.address: Dr. Mariano Azuela 12, Sta María la Ribera, Cuauhtémoc, 06400 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico
data.description:
This modern hotel in the city center is a 7-minute walk from a metro station, 2.9 km from Zócalo, the city's main square, and 7 km from Chapultepec park.
The polished rooms and suites come with free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs. Room service is available.
Parking is free. Amenities include a buffet restaurant and a laid-back bar serving light bites, along with a heated outdoor pool, a gym and a business center.
